You must first find and register for your micro-credential on https://springboardcourses.ie/. In 2-5 working days, you will receive an email which will invite you to apply directly on University of Limerick's website. Please check your spam regularly to make sure you do not miss this email.
Your application will be reviewed, and if successful, you will receive a subsidised offer from University of Limerick. This offer is strictly subject to you meeting the eligibility criteria.
We recommend reviewing your eligibility on MicroCreds.ie before applying.
The Learner Fee Subsidy is a separate scheme to Springboard+, you must apply for micro-credentials approved for the learner fee subsidy on springboardcourses.ie.
You can pay your course fee yourself and pay in instalments.
